title: Undercurrents Surging
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji finally locked onto his sister Chen Nian's location, the barrier of the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds suddenly fluctuated—and the Dragon Vein struggle in the Imperial Capital had completely spiraled out of control due to his 'death'.

text.content: Eastern suburbs of the Imperial Capital, an abandoned temple. The setting sun dyed this long-abandoned shrine blood-red. Chen Ji sat cross-legged in the shadows behind the deity statue, his entire body's aura suppressed to a near-nonexistent state, as if he had become one with this dilapidated temple. The words 'he's dead' were now spreading throughout most of the cultivation world in various forms.

dialogue.content: Your trick of 'faking death to escape' is quite exquisite—even I was fooled for three breaths.

text.content: A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips, yet there was not a trace of smugness. He lowered his head to gaze at the yellowed fragment in his palm—the third page of the Tianji Record had completely dimmed, the foresight ability falling silent after the feigned death. 'Three breaths is all it fooled you, old man. You're overestimating me.' He silently thought, raising his eyes to the sunset-scarlet horizon beyond the window. From the direction of the Imperial Capital, dragon energy faintly surged toward the heavens.

dialogue.content: The Dragon Vein struggle... is happening even faster than I anticipated.

text.content: He closed his eyes, and various forces' movements rapidly flashed through his mind. The Tianqing Sect was leaderless, the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow Su Qingyao was forced to step forward; Xuanwu Sect's first genius Han Lie took advantage to make a move, the three major sects' relations growing tense to the breaking point; and the Demonic Path Holy Sect... his sister Chen Nian's location was precisely at the eye of this storm.

dialogue.content: The barrier of the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds has cracked—three months earlier than I anticipated.
Three months... which means her Heavenly Fate Key power is awakening.

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, a flash of sharpness flickering through his gaze. The time window to rescue Chen Nian had become more urgent than he had planned. Just as he was deep in thought, a black shadow-like ghost slipped into the abandoned temple, kneeling on one knee. 'Master, the mastermind behind the broken engagement has made their move—they've sent people to the Tianqing Sect.'

dialogue.content: It's that elder from the Zhou family... He thought I was dead, wanting to take the opportunity to reopen old scores, claiming the original marriage contract was forged, wanting to completely erase this 'humiliation'.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly rose, brushing the dust from his robes, yet his eyes held only icy coldness. The humiliation of the broken engagement, he had remembered for three full years. The Zhou family thought they had latched onto a more powerful backer, not realizing they had long since planted a fatal trump card in that game of chess. 'Since they're so eager to court death, I'll grant them their wish.'

Meanwhile, inside the Golden Hall of the Imperial Capital. A middle-aged man in dragon robes sat upon the dragon throne, gazing down at the ministers prostrating before him, a meaningful smile curving his lips. 'Chen Ji is dead?' He lightly tapped the armrest, 'Interesting... The Emperor actually hopes he's truly dead. But if he were so easily killed, how could he have been chosen by the Tianji Record?'

dialogue.content: Transmit the order—proceed with the Zhou family matter as planned. Let them enjoy their smugness for three days.

text.content: Three days later, outside the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate. Zhou family elder Zhou Dehai arrived arrogantly at the sect gate with a bunch of lackeys, followed by a gray-robed elder with profound and deep aura—their expensive hired reinforcement. Zhou Dehai gazed at the tightly shut mountain gate, sneering: 'Does Su Qingyao think hiding inside will save her? Today, before the eyes of the world, I will erase every trace left by that waste Chen Ji!'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji hid in the shadows, his divine sense like silk threading through, observing every move of Zhou Dehai. When he clearly saw that gray-robed elder's face, his pupils contracted sharply—it was a renegade cultivator from the Xuanwu Sect, a wanted criminal who had assassinated three Inner Disciples. 'The Zhou family actually hired this kind of trash to deal with a 'dead man'—they really think highly of me.'

text.content: Just then, a sword light slashed into the heavens. Su Qingyao, in snow-white robes, stood atop the mountain gate, looking down at Zhou Dehai from above. Her gaze was icy, coldly sweeping over that gray-robed elder, 'Elder Zhou certainly puts on quite the show, coming to provoke our sect during our time of mourning—is this the etiquette of your Zhou family?'

dialogue.content: Zhou Dehai snorted disdainfully, 'Senior Fellow Su, Chen Ji the waste is already dead, yet you still shield him? Be sensible and step aside. Today I've come only to reclaim what belongs to my Zhou family, and，顺便...to clean up the mess that waste left behind.'

text.content: Below the mountain gate, dozens of Tianqing Sect disciples wore grim expressions, yet no one dared speak up. The news of Chen Ji's 'sudden death' three days prior still echoed in their ears, and the entire sect was in turmoil. Just as Zhou Dehai was about to force his way up the mountain, an indifferent voice suddenly rang in everyone's ears—'Elder Zhou, so eager to visit my grave?'

The voice was not loud, yet it struck like thunder in everyone's hearts. Zhou Dehai's expression changed drastically, whipping his head around to see a figure slowly stepping out from the void. Chen Ji's features were handsome, his aura unremarkable, dressed in ordinary gray robes, yet those eyes were so cold they made one's spine tingle. 'You... how can you still be alive!' Zhou Dehai was terrified, stumbling backward several steps.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji reveals himself through feigned death, facing his former broken-engagement enemy Zhou Dehai—how do you choose to slap his face?

choices.description: Publicly exposing the Zhou family's ugly history of desperately seeking the marriage alliance, making Zhou Dehai lose all face before the world
choices.visible_cost: Consume a small amount of Darkening Value
choices.visible_reward: The Zhou Family's reputation is completely ruined
choices.risk_hint: The Zhou Family might act desperately in their final moments

text.content: Chen Ji stepped forward slowly, his gaze sweeping across Zhou Dehai's ashen face, a sneer curling at the corner of his lips. 'Elder Zhou, do you need me to remind everyone present of the humiliating way your Zhou Family knelt at my Chen Family's door begging for a marriage alliance?' He took out a Jade Slip from his sleeve and casually tossed it to Su Qingyao. 'Senior Fellow Su, this contains the images of the Zhou Family's proposal visit back then. Why not let everyone have a look?'

choices.text: Do unto others as they do unto you
choices.description: Turn the Xuanwu Sect renegade cultivator that Zhou Family hired against them, publicly exposing evidence of Zhou Family's collusion with the Demonic Path
choices.visible_reward: The Zhou Family is wanted by the three major sects for the crime of betraying the sect
choices.risk_hint: The renegade cultivator might defect at the last moment

text.content: Chen Ji calmly clapped his hands. The gray-robed elder suddenly shuddered, then abruptly looked up, his eyes flickering with struggle. 'Zhou Dehai... You said as long as I killed Chen Ji you'd clear my name, but I just received news that you already sold my whereabouts to the Xuanwu Sect!' At these words, everyone erupted in uproar.

choices.text: Show weakness to the enemy and lure them deeper
choices.description: Deliberately appear weak to provoke Zhou Dehai into attacking first, then counter with thunderous force
choices.visible_reward: Publicly defeat Zhou Dehai and greatly increase Reputation
choices.risk_hint: If the acting is exposed, all previous efforts will be wasted

text.content: Chen Ji coughed lightly twice, face pale as he stepped back, as if his old injuries remained unhealed. Upon seeing this, Zhou Dehai grinned savagely. 'Ha! So you're just a paper tiger after all! Die, youtrash!' He struck with full force toward Chen Ji's crown, only to see Chen Ji's eyes flash, his form flickering like a ghost as he dodged, then countered with a palm that sent Zhou Dehai flying dozens of zhang. 'Elder Zhou, what do you think I've been doing these three years?'

However, just at this moment, an aged yet authoritative voice came from the direction of the imperial capital—'Chen Ji, you certainly are fortunate. But do you think this changes anything?' Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly. That was Ling Yuan's voice! The Tianqing Sect's former Master's aura was vast as an abyss, crossing dozens of li. 'So he's still alive... This game, as expected, is not that simple.'

Ling Yuan's pressure descended like substance. Zhou Dehai and the gray-robed elder were struck as if by lightning, kneeling and prostrating on the ground, unable to move. Yet Chen Ji walked leisurely with hands behind his back, standing upright, as if that pressure was merely a gentle breeze. 'The old Master has quite refined tastes. Having finished meddling in Tianqing Sect's trivial affairs, now interfering in my private grudge with the Zhou Family?'

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's voice carried a hint of amusement: 'Chen Ji, did you think your faked death could deceive everyone? The Tianji Record Fragment on you will sooner or later bring greater disaster. I advise you... to hand it over obediently.'

Chen Ji laughed lightly. That laughter sounded especially harsh in the silence before the Sect Gate. 'Elder Ling, your words are truly inciting. The Tianji Record is my Chen Family's ancestral artifact. What does it have to do with the Tianqing Sect? As for you... should I remind everyone present about how you were selected then rejected by the Tianji Record back in the day?'

text.content: At these words, Ling Yuan's aura abruptly stagnated. Chen Ji saw it clearly—that was not anger, but... murderous intent! 'Interesting, it seems I've poked his sore spot.' Chen Ji mused inwardly. The secrets recorded on the Tianji Record Fragment were indeed true—Ling Yuan was once a candidate for the inheritance, only ruthlessly rejected by the Tianji Record.

Just as both sides remained deadlocked, a clear voice suddenly rang in Chen Ji's mind—'Brother...' The voice was weak and vague, as if coming from extremely far away. Chen Ji's body trembled, his pupils contracting sharply. That was Chen Nian's voice! His sister was alive, and... she seemed to have sensed him!

choice.prompt: Chen Nian suddenly sent a faint spiritual sense connection. Chen Ji faces a choice:

choices.text: Follow the connection to track Chen Nian
choices.description: Risk tracing the spiritual sense source, which may expose his location but can lock onto his sister's position
choices.visible_cost: May be tracked by Ling Yuan
choices.visible_reward: Obtain clues about Chen Nian's whereabouts
choices.risk_hint: Acting under Ling Yuan's watchful eye carries extremely high risk

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered, and instantly he traced that wisp of spiritual sense. In that instant, a blurry image flashed through his mind—a petite figure bound by chains, struggling desperately in the depths of the barren forbidden zone. 'Holy Sect... forbidden grounds... three hundred li northwest...' Chen Ji firmly memorized these details, then severed the connection.

choices.description: Suppress inner anxiety, deal with Ling Yuan calmly, wait for a better opportunity
choices.visible_cost: Endure the torment of passing by his sister
choices.visible_reward: Not expose intentions, preserve room for subsequent operations
choices.risk_hint: May miss the opportunity for rescue

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath, deliberately ignoring that wisp of spiritual sense. He knew Ling Yuan's character too well—if he showed any abnormality now, the other would inevitably trace it back to Chen Nian. 'If the Elder Patriarch desires the Tianji Record, why not come take it yourself? The junior... awaits at any time.'

choices.description: Deliberately mention Chen Nian, observe Ling Yuan's reaction, probe his understanding of the Holy Sect's forbidden grounds
choices.visible_cost: Expose that he knows of Chen Nian's existence
choices.visible_reward: Probe out the relationship between Ling Yuan and the Holy Sect

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly shifted topics, looking at a certain point in the void with a knowing smile: 'By the way, Elder Patriarch, do you know who is imprisoned in the Holy Sect's forbidden grounds? They say that one's bloodline... is related to the Chen family.' As the words fell, Ling Yuan's aura visibly fluctuated for an instant. 'What did you say?!'

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao suddenly spoke, her voice cold as ice: 'Ling Elder Patriarch, instead of secluding yourself for cultivation in the sect, you come to interfere in disciples' personal grievances, what is your intention? Today's matter, my Tianqing Sect has taken note.' Her sword intent was stern, faintly counterbalancing Ling Yuan's oppressive pressure.

text.content: Ling Yuan coldly snorted, his oppressive aura suddenly withdrawing. 'Su girl, you think you can protect him?' Before the words finished, his presence had receded like the tide, 'Very well, let me see how long this mouse hiding in the shadows can continue hopping about.' The voice gradually faded in the wind, leaving only a lingering aftertaste.

Zhou Dehai was already terrified out of his wits, trying to flee by crawling and rolling. Chen Ji merely glanced at him coolly, 'Elder Zhou, I said I would make you come to sweep my grave in person... but it seems I need to change the script now.' He raised his hand and pointed, a sword qi pierced through the air, Zhou Dehai screamed as he knelt to the ground, both legs severed.

'Go back and tell the entire Zhou family, within three days, come to apologize in person, otherwise...' Chen Ji's voice was not loud, yet it was like the cold wind from the nine netherworlds, 'I won't mind eradicating the Zhou family from the cultivation world entirely.' Zhou Dehai trembled all over from the pain, nodding repeatedly, and was dragged away by the gray-robed elder in a狼狈 state.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao leaped down from the sect gate and walked to stand before Chen Ji, staring at him for a long while. 'You're indeed not dead.' Her tone was complex, containing both relief and a hint of anger at being deceived, 'For these three months, the 'news of your death' spread far and wide, while you were carefree.'

Chen Ji smiled faintly, that smile so gentle it revealed no flaws whatsoever. 'Senior Su jokes, isn't this... to draw out the snake from its hole?' He paused, his gaze profound, 'Some mice hiding in the shadows, how can they be caught without fishing them out?'

text.content: Night fell, and Chen Ji returned to the dilapidated temple in the eastern suburbs of the imperial city. The moment he entered, a jade slip emanating a faint glow flew into his palm. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out: 'This is the second batch of information from your sister... The other half of the Chen family's lost bloodline, you must find it quickly.'

dialogue.content: The other half of the Chen family's bloodline? What does that mean?

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul flickered slightly, as if weighing his words. 'Back then, the Chen family fell apart, the core bloodline split in two. Your sister was taken by the Holy Sect, and you... are the visible half. The hidden half is concealed in a place even I cannot calculate.'

text.content: Chen Ji's fingers gripping the jade slip turned slightly pale. 'So to save Nian'er, I must first find that half of the bloodline?' Mo Xiansheng did not answer, but silence itself was the answer. Chen Ji closed his eyes, drew a deep breath, and when he opened them again, his gaze held only resolve. 'Alright... I've noted it.'

At that moment, inside the Golden Luann Hall of the Imperial Capital. After hearing the Shadow Guard's report, the dragon-robed man's lips curved into an even more playful smile. "Interesting... faked death to escape, publicly humiliated Ling Yuan... this Chen Ji is far more intriguing than I anticipated." He rose and gazed out the window at the night sky, murmuring: "The variable of the Tianji Record... perhaps it can truly tip this deadlocked game."

Just then, a诡异 aura suddenly enveloped the entire Imperial Capital. The dragon-robed man's expression shifted slightly as he abruptly looked up toward the void. Above, in the苍穹 invisible to the naked eye, an无形 eye was gazing down upon this land—the Heavenly Dao's Eye, an existence beyond everything. It had no emotions, no sense of good or evil, only eternal observation.

"Interesting... another piece has started to defy orders." The will of the Heavenly Dao's Eye swept across the direction where Chen Ji resided like a tide, yet it only touched upon emptiness—the Tianji Record Fragment was emanating a faint shielding force. However, that will showed no anger; instead, it carried a hint of anticipation.

dialogue.content: "Go, variable. Let me see how far you can go... If you can make this stagnant water stir up even greater waves, I shall permit you... to live a bit longer."

text.content: Inside the broken temple, Chen Ji suddenly shuddered. He raised his head to gaze at the night sky, a flicker of imperceptible vigilance flashing through his eyes. In that instant, he felt as if some terrifying existence had fixed its gaze upon him—that sensation was cold, vast, transcendent, like an ant being observed by the Heavenly Dao. "Who? The Heavenly Dao's Eye? Or something else?"

Chen Ji withdrew his gaze, lowering his head to look at the Tianji Record Fragment in his palm. The pale golden glow flickered faintly, seemingly responding to his emotions. He murmured softly: "Regardless of who's watching... this chess game, I will not play according to your script." He rose and pushed open the temple window, night wind rushing in and stirring his robes.

Dragon energy surged in the Imperial Capital direction; the three great sects' struggles intensified; deep within the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds, his younger sister Chen Nian was desperately struggling to survive; Ling Yuan's shadow loomed like thorns at his back, ready to strike again at any moment; and that mysterious other half of the Chen family's bloodline remained unfound... Chen Ji closed his eyes, rapidly organizing all the intelligence in his mind.

"First, find the other half of the Chen family's lost bloodline—this is the key to saving Nian'er." Chen Ji opened his eyes, his gaze sharp as a blade. "Second, take advantage of the chaos to intervene in the Dragon Vein dispute, carving out a share from the dynasty's politics. Third, ascertain Ling Yuan's trump cards, gaining the initiative in the next round of confrontation." A cold smile curled at the corner of his mouth. "Interesting... this chess game is becoming more and more interesting."

Chen Ji cast one final glance toward the Imperial Capital, where lights blazed brilliantly, yet countless schemes and lethal traps lurked within. He turned and vanished into the night, his figure disappearing like a specter. The faked-death gambit has been initiated; the true game of strategy has only just begun. While all struggle in the light, a hidden chess master is quietly placing a crucial piece.
